sources.snippet: EfficientFormer: Optimized for Mobile Deployment Imagenet classifier and general purpose backbone EfficientFormer is a vision transformer model that can classify images from the Imagenet dataset. This model is an implementation of EfficientFormer found here. This repository provides scripts to run EfficientFormer on Qualcomm® devices.
